clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Requirements of lead pipes for other than chemical purposes. The lead pipes covered in this standard are not suitable for potable water supply.

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects
clauses.text: 2. Freedom from Defects:  Shall be sound in all respect and free from laminations, flaws, pronounced extrusion marks or other harmful defects and shall, as far as possible, be circular in cross section, smooth and of uniform wall thickness throughout.

clauses.title: The tolerance on the
clauses.text: 6.1 The tolerance on the nominal internal diameter shall be + 0% and — 5%.

clauses.title: The tolerance on wall
clauses.text: 6.2 The tolerance on wall thickness shall be ± 7.5 percent.
